name: Uplifter Glassworker GW625 glazing robot
summary: Radio-controlled glazing robot with a 3 kW front drive and a six-cup vacuum cross on a hydraulic extension that unloads, carries and installs glass and facade elements of up to 625 kg, also over uneven site ground. Made and rented out by Uplifter in Guteneck, Bavaria.

germany.statusNote: Sold and rented by the German maker Uplifter (Guteneck, Bavaria) through purchase, rental and used-machine request forms on the product page; no price shown. Delivered with operating instructions and CE declaration of conformity.

sellers.name: Uplifter Service GmbH
sellers.note: 92543 Guteneck, Germany. Purchase request, rental request and used-machine enquiry on the product page; e-mail addresses on the contact page are hidden behind spam protection.

specs.label: Hydraulic side shift of vacuum cross
specs.quote: Hydraulic side shift in vacuum cross (+/- 50 mm)

specs.label: Front drive
specs.conditions: product configurator lists a standard battery option

notes: Arm = hydraulic extension with a vacuum cross; hydraulic turning and swivelling, automatic angle correction; options include a 3D manipulator, load hook, forklift fork and crane tip.
Remote-controlled by one operator with a radio remote with LCD display; not autonomous.
Tyres: pneumatic as standard, white non-marking or solid PUR tyres as options.
Maker says it unloads, carries and installs panes even over uneven ground on site (roughGround is a maker claim).
Offered as Standard and Highlifter model; the heights given are for the Highlifter.

evidence.task: Unloads, transports and installs large glass panes and facade elements on construction sites with one operator
